# Authoring a persona

This file explains how to write a new persona from TEMPLATE.md. It is not
itself a persona and must never be listed as one.

1. Copy TEMPLATE.md to a new kebab-case filename matching the persona name.
2. Fill in the frontmatter: name, title, lens, hunts, version, provenance.
3. Write each body section honestly; do not pad it out.
4. Keep the changelog current when the persona changes.
